LESSON: KUSOMA 8.2.1 KUSOMA KWA KINA NOVELA

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: ULAGUZI WA BINADAMU Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli za Uj
Topic 8.2: Kusoma 8.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 8.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya mandhari na ploti katika fasihi
2. kutambua mandhari mbalimbali na ploti ya novela
3. kueleza umuhimu wa mandhari na ploti ya novela

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya mandhari na ploti katika fasihi
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya mandhari na ploti katika fasihi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua mandhari mbalimbali na ploti ya novela
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua mandhari mbalimbali na ploti ya novela. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kueleza umuhimu wa mandhari na ploti ya novela
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza umuhimu wa mandhari na ploti ya novela. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 8.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 8.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 8.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 8.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya mandhari na ploti katika fasihi

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 8.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 8.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya mandhari na ploti katika fasihi
2. kutambua mandhari mbalimbali na ploti ya novela
3. kueleza umuhimu wa mandhari na ploti ya novela

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
